# Signalith 0.3.2

- With `detections.sync: mirror`, a server whose detections or dashboards folder is found empty (or that would remove many shared files of one kind at once) no longer deletes the shared library on every server: it removes nothing of that kind, writes the files back, and says so in its log, the audit log and the Servers page. This guards against accidents, not against removals made a few files at a time. To allow one such removal, put a file named `allow-mass-delete` in that folder and remove the files within the hour. See [Servers](https://signalith.io/docs/servers/#shared-detections-dashboards-and-asset-lists).
